name: LED (5 mm)
description: 5 mm through-hole indicator LED. Needs a series resistor: about 220 Ω at 5 V. The long leg (A) is the anode.

pins.label: Anode (+)
pins.description: Anode, the longer leg. Goes towards +.

pins.label: Cathode (−)
pins.description: Cathode, the shorter leg on the flat side of the rim. Goes towards GND.

props.label: Colour
props.description: Emission colour. Sets the forward voltage.

footprint: THT 5 mm round LED, 0.1 in (2.54 mm) lead pitch

bindings.description: Perceived brightness 0..1 (0 below 0.1 mA, 1 at 20 mA).
Glow colour as a hex string for the current colour prop.
Unlit lens tint as a hex string.
